title: _Ex vivo_ BIN1/Amphiphysin 2-induced tubulation of membranes, and visualization of Dynamin 2 recruitment to the membrane tubules
protocol: Inoculate COS-1 cells in a 75 cm² cell culture flask and grow in DMEM + 1g/L glucose + 5% FCS to 100% confluence.
Dilute the cells 1:4 in same medium and spread on 22 mm² glasses into 6 wells tissue culture plate.
Let the cells adhere and grow for 5 hours at 37°C.
Mix 100 microl. DMEM (without glucose nor FCS) with 3 microl. Fugene-6 transfection reagent and 1 microg. of plasmids DNA encoding the proteins of interest, pEGFP-BIN1 iso 8 and pSG5 Myc-tagged-DNM2.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Add the mixture to cells in 1 ml DMEM + 1g/L glucose + 5% FCS.
Incubate overnight at 37°C.
Wash cells with PBS once.
Fix the cells with 4% paraformaldehyde for 20 min to overnight at 4°C.
Quench with NH₄Cl 50mM for 15 minutes.
Wash cells with PBS for 5 minutes before permeabilisation with PBS + 0.2% Triton for 10 minutes.
Wash cells with PBS for 5 minutes.
Saturate non specific immunoglobulin binding sites with PBS + 0.1% Triton + 10% FCS for 1 hour.
Wash cells with PBS for 5 minutes.
Dilute primary antibody \(anti-Myc) 1:400 in PBS + 0.1% Triton + 3% FCS.
Transfer 22 mm² glasses carrying cells into a humid chamber to avoid drying during incubations.
Incubate cells on 22 mm² glasses with primary antibody dilution for 1 hr at room temperature.
Wash cells three times with PBS + 0.1% Triton for 5-10 min.
Dilute secondary antibody \(Goat anti Mouse Cy3) 1:200 in PBS + 0.1% Triton + 3% FCS.
Incubate on cells for 45 min at room temperature.
Wash cells three times with PBS + 0.1% Triton for 5-10 min.
Wash cells once with PBS for 5-10 min.
Mount glasses on microscope slides with a drop of anti-fading solution, ensuring cells face the slides.
Use a confocal microscope with an Argon 488 excitation to visualize GFP-BIN1 positive membrane tubules.
Use a HeNe 543 excitation for red Myc-DNM2 localization.
